# Trace server dependencies
#
# Flask        — web framework
# gunicorn     — production WSGI server used in the container image
# psycopg2-binary — Postgres driver. Required for the default container/k3s
#                deployment, which uses a dedicated Postgres database. It's
#                harmless for SQLite-only local use (just unused), so it's
#                included unconditionally to keep one image for both backends.

Flask>=3.0,<4.0
gunicorn>=21.2,<23.0
psycopg2-binary>=2.9,<3.0
